name: Châtel
description: Châtel is a real farming village on the French-Swiss border in the Portes du Soleil. Its own Espace Liberté ski area has 120 km of pistes across 3 sectors: Super-Châtel (beginner bowl), Linga (advanced, 800m vertical, snowpark), and Pré-la-Joux (link to Avoriaz). Also connected to the Swiss resorts of Morgins and Torgon. 56 lifts, 69 pistes. Gourmet destination with Abondance cheese from local farms. Fantasticable giant zip line (100 km/h, 140m high). Forme d'O aquatic centre. 60+ restaurants across the villages and slopes.

overview.atmosphere: Authentic Savoyard farming village in the Portes du Soleil. Working farms producing Abondance cheese. 3 ski sectors (Super-Châtel, Linga, Pré-la-Joux). Fantasticable zip line. Gourmet destination with 2 Michelin-recommended restaurants.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Snowshoeing, paragliding, hot air balloon, escape game, cinema, bobsled run at Pré-la-Joux, guided snowshoe trails, e-MTB on snow, treasure hunt, Abondance Abbey

honest_drawbacks: Spread across 11 hamlets — car/shuttle often needed
Lower altitude base (1,200m) — snow variable in valley
